sections.text_helper: Section 8.4.4 "IAC use in RIF" in chapter 8 (Illegal access controller (IAC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 282.
sections.section_content:
The IAC gathers illegal events generated within the system when an illegal access is
detected. The IAC can then generate a secure interrupt towards the secure CPU, if needed.
By default, all events in the IAC are masked.
The IAC has room for 160 interrupt sources. Each source corresponds to an IAC index
from0 to 159. The interrupt sources from non-RIF-aware peripherals occupy most of the
first 128 indexes. The interrupt sources from RIF-aware peripherals and RIF firewalls
occupy indexes from 128 onwards. All these sources are defined in Section8.3.
